details: Bitcoin's price is experiencing renewed downward pressure as MicroStrategy's STRC preferred stock has fallen below par, potentially signaling forced selling. Additionally, five consecutive months of Bitcoin trading below its estimated $78,000 production cost are pushing weaker miners towards capitulation, creating further selling pressure in the market. Over $450 million in leveraged long positions were liquidated in the past 24 hours, indicating a market susceptible to further declines.
title: Bitcoin Under Pressure as MicroStrategy's STRC Collapses and Miners Capitulate
